brief:
A U.S. military operation struck a boat in Sudan, killing at least five civilians, Drop Site News reported. The incident occurred as violence continues across the country amid ongoing conflict.

Israeli parliamentary elections produced no clear winner, leaving coalition negotiations uncertain. Simultaneously, a separate attack in Sudan claimed over 100 lives, adding to the country's mounting toll from months of internal strife.
title: U.S. boat strike kills five Sudanese civilians
